articles.title: Coldcard reveals how security reviews missed Bitcoin wallet flaw for over 5 years
articles.description: Coldcard maker Coinkite explained why years of security checks failed to catch the flaw and said it has yet to decide on compensation for affected customers.

articles.title: CFTC sets new prediction market rules as more firms seek US entry
articles.description: The US regulator has approved permanent reporting rules for certain event contracts as more companies look to launch prediction markets.

articles.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
articles.description: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
articles.description: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.

articles.title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
articles.description: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

articles.title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
articles.description: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.

articles.title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
articles.description: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.

articles.title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
articles.description: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.

articles.title: Grayscale calls Bitcoin ‘oversold’ at $62K but warns of AI risks
articles.description: Grayscale said Bitcoin’s bear market was its longest on record at 411 days and counting, though the 56% drop was the smallest percentage decline.

articles.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
articles.description: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

articles.title: Bitcoin dipped on Huang’s Nvidia exit but jumped 5% on his return
articles.description: Bitcoin rose about 5% on Jensen Huang’s return, more than the 3.5% it lost on news of his exit, but remained 19.2% below its pre-resignation price.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
articles.description: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
articles.description: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Why 42 Macro says it’s waiting to buy the Bitcoin dip
articles.description: The independent macro research company warns the Bitcoin sell-off may not have yet run its course.

articles.title: Google wants to make you the star of your own AI slop movies
articles.description: Viewers could find their AI-doppelgangers inserted into the crowd during the Cricket World Cup, or take a leading role in their very own romantic comedy.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
articles.description: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

articles.title: CFTC staff say exchanges can count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
articles.description: The staff guidance allows Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins to count towards operating reserves.

articles.title: US seeks to recover $1.1B in crypto stolen in North Korea-linked Binance hack
articles.description: US prosecutors are seeking control of stolen USDC, while Elliptic says hackers have moved $247 million through Bitcoin mixers.

articles.title: Kalshi secures temporary win in New York gambling law dispute
articles.description: The ruling allows Kalshi to continue operating as its legal battle with New York over sports-related event contracts moves toward a January hearing.

articles.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
articles.description: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

articles.title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
articles.description: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

articles.title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
articles.description: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
articles.description: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.

articles.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
articles.description: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.

articles.title: How market depth shapes the price of a weekend Bitcoin sale
articles.description: Over 14 hours, Bitcoin traded on Kraken’s Canadian dollar market at an average 37.3% discount to a benchmark based on the exchange’s US dollar trades.

articles.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO amid ongoing intelligence probe
articles.description: Nvidia shares surged nearly 29% after the company’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following consultations with the US government.

articles.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
articles.description: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.

articles.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin secures $150M credit line from FalconX
articles.description: The miner can borrow against its Bitcoin to fund operations and expansion after selling about 465 BTC to cover expenses in the third quarter.

articles.title: Strategy buys 457 Bitcoin, spends $212M on preferred share buybacks
articles.description: Strategy raised its preferred stock buyback limit to $4 billion and authorized the transfer of up to $1 billion from its dollar reserve.
